name: @w6w-apps/kvcore
description: Manage contacts, notes, tags, users, offices and teams in kvCORE / BoldTrail, Inside Real Estate's real-estate CRM.

w6w.longDescription:
kvCORE (by Inside Real Estate, now rebranded BoldTrail) is a real-estate CRM and lead-engine platform: brokerages and agent teams run their contact database, lead routing, agent websites and office/team structure through it. This app covers the kvCORE Public API V2 — the API that is actually live today at `api.kvcore.com` — for contact and lead management (create, read, list, update, tag, and note contacts) and account administration (create, read, list, update and delete users, offices and teams, including team/office membership).

Inside Real Estate is mid-rebrand: its developer hub now documents a *second*, OAuth-based BoldTrail API (`api.boldtrail.com`) that its own docs describe as beta and invite-only as of this writing, with no self-serve way to obtain a client. This app deliberately targets the V2 API instead, because it is the one a workflow can actually authenticate against today: any kvCORE user can self-issue a scoped bearer token from their own Lead Dropbox, no partner approval required.

Every endpoint, field and error shape here was verified against the vendor's own OpenAPI 3.1 document (embedded in `developer.insiderealestate.com`'s reference pages, fetched 2026-09-29) plus a live, unauthenticated probe against `api.kvcore.com` on the same day.
